title: Throat of the Furnace
description: A screaming dirty-bass riser built from a detuned sawtooth core fused with a layer of white noise, dragged upward by a slow pitch-glide while a resonant ladder filter journeys from sub-rumble to a top-end shriek across the full register. Over 32 cycles the noise blend, FM scream and filter sweep climb on separate clocks so each pass tears open wider before snapping back.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 c1 c2>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .noise(sine.slow(24).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .fm(saw.slow(16).range(2, 11)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 3>/8")
    .accelerate(saw.slow(32).range(0, 7))
    .penv("<0 7 14 24>/8").pattack(0.002).pdecay(0.5)
    .lpf(saw.slow(32).range(120, 7500)).resonance(19).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(6).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.3)
    .shape(sine.slow(11).range(0.3, 0.6)).distort("<1 1 2 3>/16")
    .attack(0.01).decay(0.25).sustain(0.6).release(0.1)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.crush("<8 5>"))
    .off(1/16, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.3).hpf(900))
    .room(0.3).delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").gain(0.9)
)
